instances.claim: This tells me that the work's continual redefinition is the film's conclusion, and that the draft has nothing more to add about it — the same claim arrives three times in different vocabulary.
instances.why: Line 16 already makes the redefinition point in the mechanism register (decentralized consensus continually redefining the inscription); 17 ('ongoing process of redefinition'), 22 ('indeterminate and continually redefined') and 23 ('a becoming... unfolds continually') then restate it with no change of level — the shared roots 'redefin-' and 'continual-' mark it. Only 23 earns its place, adding the form register (what kind of thing CENTS is) and the participants who do the redefining; 17 and 22 are each another word for the last.
